item.description:
1.2.0

  • The battery pill on a speaker row stays on one line; long room names truncate instead.
  • Opening Up Next no longer shrinks or clips the Home map.
  • Up Next always shows Spotify's live queue.
  • Pressing Play on a Spotify Connect room resumes it in place instead of rebuilding a Sonos queue, including a room whose Connect session has gone dormant.
  • Tapping a song in Up Next on a Spotify Connect room skips forward to it and keeps the room on Spotify Connect.
  • Preset pills sit in the toolbar on every page.
  • The Now Playing bar lines up with the map's floor plates and page content.
  • Turn shuffle on and off from the Now Playing bar when Spotify is playing on a Sonos room over Spotify Connect, or on another device such as a phone or computer.

1.1.3

  • Dragging a speaker onto a room or group it can join gives a light tick on the trackpad or iPhone.
  • Grouping and ungrouping speakers now confirm with a haptic once Sonos finishes the change. On iPhone, a failed regroup plays an error haptic.

1.1.2

  • Speakers from another Sonos system (say, the office) no longer show up as offline rooms at home. Each network keeps its own rooms, and they come back when you return to that network.

1.1.1

  • No user-facing changes. DylKit now ships from its own repository.

1.1.0

  • Sconeos has a Settings window (⌘,) with automatic update checks and an About page.
  • When an update is found at launch, its dialog now comes forward instead of hiding behind other windows.
  • The update dialog lists only the versions newer than the one you're running.
  • The download site's install help now covers Macs where "Open Anyway" fails.

1.0.11

  • When there's no Sonos system on the network you're on, Sconeos shows one "No Sonos system on this network" card. It no longer shows a wall of Offline rooms from home.
  • On a network with a different Sonos system, Sconeos connects to that system and shows its rooms. The rooms saved from the last network don't come along.
  • Battery speakers like Move and Roam show Offline on the map when they can't be reached. Before, they showed a battery badge and looked online.

1.0.10

  • Sconeos no longer stalls the window at launch while it restores the Spotify session and reads saved room positions.
  • Moving or resetting a room pin no longer blocks the map while the change is written to disk.

1.0.9

  • Catch up on skipped updates: If you skipped versions, the update dialog now lists what changed in each one since, newest first (up to the last 10 versions).
  • Full version history link: The update dialog links to the complete release history on GitHub.

1.0.8

  • Replaced the waveform icon with the new "Scone Cone" icon (a baked scone wedge speaker cone with honey-glass sound arcs) across macOS, iOS, the web landing icon, and the in-app sidebar emblem.
  • Fixed light, dark, and tinted app icon switching across macOS 26 and iOS 26 so the app icon and in-app emblem dynamically match the active appearance.

1.0.7

  • Fix Sparkle update signature validation: Pin ad-hoc signed app bundles to a bundle-identifier designated requirement (designated => identifier "com.sconeos.SconeOS") so Sparkle updates succeed across builds instead of failing with code-signature error -67050.
  • Verify update signatures at release time: Require sparkle:edSignature and cryptographically verify it against SUPublicEDKey in Info.plist during release packaging.
